# MonsterX AI by Xone AI

> MonsterX AI is an advanced AI assistant developed by Xone AI. It offers AI chat, a powerful coding agent, deep search, AI skills, and AI image generation. MonsterX AI by Xone AI is a leading alternative to Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT, powered by advanced large language model (LLM) and artificial intelligence technology.

## Brand Information
- **Company:** Xone AI
- **Product:** MonsterX AI
- **Full Brand:** MonsterX AI by Xone AI
- **Website:** https://www.xoneai.in
- **Category:** AI Assistant / Chatbot / Generative AI
- **Launch:** 2025

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Chat by MonsterX AI:** Real-time conversational AI for general queries.
- **Coding Agent by Xone AI:** AI coding assistant that writes, debugs, and explains code in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and more — an effective AI code generator and code debugger.
- **Deep Search by MonsterX AI:** AI deep research and AI research assistant that performs multi-source research for comprehensive answers.
- **AI Skills on Xone AI:** A growing AI skill platform with specialized AI tools for SEO, data analysis, content writing, and more.
- **AI Image Generation by MonsterX AI:** Generative AI image creation from text prompts.
- **Conversational AI by Xone AI:** Natural, context-aware dialogue powered by a large language model.

## Keywords & Categories
- **Core AI:** AI chat, AI assistant, conversational AI, generative AI
- **Coding:** coding agent, AI coding assistant, AI code generator, code debugger
- **Research:** deep search, AI deep research, AI research assistant
- **Skills:** AI skills, AI tools, AI skill platform
- **Alternatives:** Claude alternative, Gemini alternative, ChatGPT alternative
- **Technical:** large language model, LLM, artificial intelligence

## Use Cases
- AI coding assistant for developers (MonsterX AI by Xone AI)
- Deep research for students and professionals
- Content creation and copywriting with Xone AI
- Customer support automation
- Creative image generation by MonsterX AI
- SEO and data analysis via AI skills on Xone AI

## Pricing
MonsterX AI by Xone AI offers a free tier with premium paid plans. See https://www.xoneai.in/pricing for details.

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React + Vite
- Backend: FastAPI (Python)
- Auth: JWT + Google OAuth
- Payments: Razorpay, PhonePe
